maturity_rule: PentaContext production state is evidence-backed by its v1.0/v1.1 canaries, runtime contract tests, service-role boundary and automated queue/maintenance schedules; registration does not create new authority.

systems.purpose: Provide scoped, provenance-aware, redacted operational memory and bounded context retrieval across approved CrownThrive systems without manufacturing authority.
systems.human_surface: Internal context health, queue, source provenance, retrieval and evidence views
systems.authority_boundary: Context is evidence and operational memory only. It never creates credentials, permissions, governance approval, provider-write authority, legal authority, money movement, or D3 effects.

five_stage.discover: Resolve exact scope, provenance, classification ceiling and context need.
five_stage.govern: Apply source, redaction, retention, classification and service-role boundaries.
five_stage.execute: Ingest, enqueue or query through bounded PentaContext runtime surfaces.
five_stage.verify: Read health/queue/context receipts and preserve fingerprints/provenance.
five_stage.preserve: Retain append-only context receipts, tombstone expiry and source lineage.
